title: Paloma and the Oath
premise: Isandro Villalobos, a mercenary bound by oath to the Silent God, has spent his life guarding the valley where magic cannot follow — until his date, Paloma Reyes, is named in a century-old book of prophecies and dragged into the court beneath the mountain. To save her, Isandro must break his oath and carry magic into the valley for the first time, discovering that the Silent God never abandoned him but was imprisoned by the mountain court, which feeds on stolen souls. Paloma learns her own soul was sold generations ago by an ancestor, making her both prophecy's instrument and its intended sacrifice. Together they rally the misfit found family of the valley's outcasts, storm the court beneath the mountain, free the Silent God, and reclaim Paloma's soul — choosing love and belonging over duty's letter, and ending with a new oath sworn freely rather than imposed.
about_author: Casper Crane is the pen name of a former stonemason who spent a decade restoring cathedral walls before turning to fiction, and it shows in every carved sentence. They write fantasy about oaths, labor, and the people history forgets to name.

chapters.title: The Valley Where Magic Cannot Follow
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. A routine patrol along the valley's boundary stones establishes the world: mercenary oaths, the Silent God's empty shrine, and the strange deadness of magic at the border. Isandro saves a lost traveler from a boundary wraith, showing his competence and loneliness. Emotional beat: quiet devotion hollowed into habit.

chapters.title: A Date in the Ordinary World
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. On leave, Isandro meets Paloma Reyes, a cartographer cataloguing the valley's impossible geography, for their first real date. Their chemistry is warm and awkward; she sketches maps that feel eerily familiar to him. Emotional beat: hope, fragile as first light.

chapters.title: The Book That Knew Her Name
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. In the valley archive, Paloma finds a century-old prophetic codex describing tonight's date verbatim — down to spilled wine on her sleeve. The final entry names her soul as payment due beneath the mountain. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread.

chapters.title: Taken Beneath
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The prophecy activates: shadow-hounds of the mountain court seize Paloma mid-sentence and drag her through a seam in the earth. Isandro's oath-marks flare for the first time in years — the Silent God stirring. Emotional beat: helpless fury and the first crack in obedience.

chapters.title: The Oath's Weight
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The valley elders forbid pursuit: crossing into magic means breaking the oath that protects everyone. Isandro interrogates the dying hound and learns Paloma's soul was sold long ago — she was always meant to be collected. Emotional beat: duty and love pulling in opposite directions.

chapters.title: Down the Stair of Roots
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Defying the elders, Isandro descends through the root-stair beneath the boundary stone, where magic floods back into him painfully after a lifetime without it. He rescues a half-drowned stranger, Marisol, a runaway witch also fleeing the court. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration of becoming more than human.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. Paloma wakes in the subterranean court, gilded and rotting, ruled by the Regent Below who claims her ancestor signed away her soul. She is treated as honored property, shown her own name in the ledger of souls. Emotional beat: gilded cage, cold clarity.

chapters.title: Marisol's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Marisol (new POV). Marisol guides Isandro toward the court, revealing she once served the Regent and knows its hunger: it devours gods, which is how the Silent God went silent. She demands a price — a place in the valley afterward. Emotional beat: wary alliance, transactional trust.

chapters.title: Ledger of Souls
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. Paloma plays docile while studying the court's ledger, discovering hundreds of valley souls sold across generations — including children she recognizes from above. She steals a page as proof and finds a hidden passage behind the throne. Emotional beat: from victim to spy.

chapters.title: Reunion in Chains
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Isandro infiltrates the court during a feast of shadows and finds Paloma — but touching her triggers the soul-contract, marking him too. They share one desperate moment before guards separate them. Emotional beat: reunion sharpened into stakes.

chapters.title: What the Silent God Was
chapters.summary: POV Marisol. Imprisoned beside Isandro, Marisol reveals the truth: the Silent God is not silent but caged beneath the court, and the valley's magic-dead zone was created to hide and protect Him. The oath-keepers were unknowingly His jailers' unwitting allies. Emotional beat: faith shattered and reformed.

chapters.title: The Regent's Offer
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. The Regent offers Paloma freedom if she renounces Isandro and accepts her role willingly — promising prosperity for the valley in exchange. She sees the trap but also the temptation of being chosen rather than owed. Emotional beat: seduction of surrender.

chapters.title: Breaking the Oath
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Facing execution, Isandro formally breaks his oath aloud — and instead of destroying him, the oath-marks transform, revealing they were chains disguised as blessings. Freed, he can now wield true power. Emotional beat: liberation through betrayal of a lie.

chapters.title: Escape Through the Bone Galleries
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. Using her stolen ledger page as a key, Paloma frees Isandro and Marisol, and they flee through bone galleries patrolled by the hounds. Paloma's mapmaker instincts turn the labyrinth against their pursuers. Emotional beat: partnership forged under fire.

chapters.title: The Price of the Page
chapters.summary: POV Marisol. The stolen page burns away Marisol's protection; the court brands her traitor and hunts her specifically. Wounded, she confesses she led Isandro down partly to steal a soul for herself. Emotional beat: guilt, forgiveness asked and slowly given.

chapters.title: Rallying the Outcasts
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Back in the valley, Isandro presents the ledger to the elders, who refuse to act. Instead he gathers the outcasts — boundary-witch Marisol, exiled smiths, the traveler he once saved — into a ragged war band. Emotional beat: found family assembling around a shared wound.

chapters.title: The Descent War-Band
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. The company returns underground with weapons blessed by the valley's dead traditions. Paloma leads them through passages only she has mapped, ambushing the court's outer guard. First real victory. Emotional beat: courage compounding into momentum.

chapters.title: The Cage of the Silent God
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. They reach the god's prison: a cathedral of silence where sound dies. Isandro speaks his broken oath backward, unmaking the original binding, and the Silent God opens one eye. Emotional beat: awe, and the cost beginning — the mountain starts to shake.

chapters.title: The Regent Unmasked
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. Confrontation with the Regent, revealed as the first oath-taker who sold the god to gain the court. Paloma offers her own soul back voluntarily — a loophole that voids the contract, since it was never truly hers to sell. Emotional beat: sacrifice as strategy and love.

chapters.title: When the Mountain Sings
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Climax. The freed Silent God rises through the mountain; the Regent is unmade by the very contracts He authored. Isandro nearly dies holding the collapsing stair so the others escape, saved at the last by Paloma refusing to leave him. Emotional beat: everything risked, everything nearly lost.

chapters.title: Souls Returned
chapters.summary: POV Paloma. The ledger dissolves, returning stolen souls across the valley — the dead dream again, the living remember names. Paloma feels her own soul settle back into her like a homecoming. Marisol receives her place among them. Emotional beat: restitution, grief braided with joy.

chapters.title: A New Oath, Freely Sworn
chapters.summary: POV Isandro and Paloma, alternating. Magic now flows gently through the valley; the Silent God speaks at last, asking nothing. Isandro and Paloma swear a new vow at the boundary stone — not duty imposed, but belonging chosen. Emotional beat: home, finally, in each other and in community.
